title: Full Pyramid
description: Athletic circuit then mountain climber pyramid for a complete full body session

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot side to side

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower, come halfway up, lower again, stand fully

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Dive-bomb movement: dip down then sweep up in an arc

exercises.name: RKC plank
exercises.instructions: Plank with maximum tension, squeeze fists and glutes

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
